Ad spend

Your ads need a front door that pays back

You're already paying for attention. A free class with an offer on the thank-you page turns some of that spend back into revenue on day one, before anyone books a call.

No qualifier

Applicants arrive cold

Someone can go from one reel to a 1:1 application with no idea how you work. A class lets them see your intuitive, root-cause approach first, so the people who apply already get it.

Content treadmill

3,455 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post and the next episode. Without a class capturing emails every day, quiet weeks on social show up as quiet weeks in your diary.

The people who love your content but aren't ready for 1:1 today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A free masterclass that sells the MYH app and fills your 1:1 care

You already have the traffic and the products. What's missing is one free 60-minute class that teaches your root-pattern approach, offers the MYH app on the thank-you page, and invites the right people to apply for 1:1. It gives the ads you already run a better place to send people.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"Why your friend's plan isn't your plan"

Hook
"Your friend cut one thing out and felt amazing. Someone else tries it and nothing changes. Here's why." (to camera, kitchen setting)
Body
"Functional nutrition doesn't start with a protocol. It starts with patterns: how food, stress, sleep and rhythm fit together for one person. When you look at the whole picture, the next step gets a lot clearer." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I'm teaching this lens in a free 60-minute class called Root Patterns. Tap Sign up to save your seat."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions I ask first"

Hook
"Before I talk about any supplement, these are the three questions I ask." (Erin holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: what are your meals actually like day to day? Two: what's your stress load right now? Three: how are you sleeping? The foundations first, then everything else." (caption for each question)
CTA
"In my free masterclass I go through how I look at the whole picture. Link below. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with my work"

Hook
"People ask me whether to start with the app, the podcast or 1:1. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"If you're new, don't pick yet. Come to my free class first. You'll learn how I think about root patterns, see what an intuitive, functional approach feels like, and know which next step fits you."
CTA
"It's called Root Patterns, it's free, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
